The clause adds that the second moment (Wightman two-point) FIXES the trace -- i.e. supplies the otherwise-free positive scalar that the trace-scaling group leaves undetermined. This is faithful, NOT an overstatement: the crossed product gives uniqueness-up-to-scalar; the physical second moment picks the representative.
